description:
The rig innovation shows how moonshiners are constantly upgrading their stills and mobile setups to make their operations more efficient, flexible, and harder to shut down. Mark and Digger experiment with new inventions to improve their process and repurpose a carnival ride into a whiskey-aging setup, while Josh turns a race car trailer into a mobile moonshining rig, and Jerry develops a high-tech solution to a backwoods problem and more!
#Moonshiners Tuesdays at 8P on #Discovery

Stream Full Episodes of Moonshiners:
https://www.discoveryplus.com/show/moonshiners

About Moonshiners:
Every spring, a fearless group of men and women venture deep into the woods of Appalachia, defying the law, rivals and nature itself to keep the centuries-old tradition of craft whiskey alive.
